title: Ankh Resurrection
description: Mod adds post-mortum challenge for players to retrieve their items.
body:
Resurrection adds a unique resurrection system. When a player dies, their items and experience are preserved by a powerful undead guardian that appears at the place of death.

To recover everything, the undead must be defeated before time runs out. Once defeated, a corpse appears containing all of the player's belongings. 
Using an Ancient artifact on the corpse will fully retrieve player's belongings, armor and experience.
Fail to complete the resurrection before the timer expires, and everything will be lost forever.

Perfect for multiplayer adventures, cooperative survival worlds, and servers where every death becomes a challenge for a player or his friends instead of an instant setback.
